records.title: 10-K
records.text: Sales of Grand Theft Auto products generated 14.7% of our net revenue for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2024.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: For the fiscal year ended March 31, 2024, Net Bookings increased by $49.4 as compared to the prior year.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: For the fiscal year ended March 31, 2024, our net loss was $3,744.2, as compared to net loss of $1,124.7 in the prior year.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Further, as a result of the platform fees associated with online game sales, our mobile net revenue generally generates a lower gross margin percentage than our Console or PC revenue.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Our operating loss for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2024 was $3,590.6 compared to operating loss of $1,165.2 for fiscal year ended March 31, 2023, primarily due to Goodwill impairment charges of $2,342.1, representing a partial impairment related to one of our reporting units.
